source_law_text: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator, the driver or operator shall: If the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in the direction in which the driver or operator is traveling, drive in the extreme right-hand lane except when necessary to pass other slowly moving vehicles.
